PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Declares it in the manifest's required_settings so a missing key fails loudly at import
- Adds it to .env.example with an empty value and never commits a real key
- Uses a settings partial or gated integration pattern rather than duplicating config across environment files

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
